articles.title: Metaplanet delays preferred share listing amid challenging Japanese market structure
articles.snippet: CEO Simon Gerovich says regulatory and infrastructure challenges are slowing the launch of Metaplanet's perpetual preferred share.

articles.title: UK parliament to probe Nigel Farage’s $6.8 million donation from crypto billionaire
articles.snippet: If found guilty of violating the Parliamentary code of conduct, the Reform UK party leader could be suspended from the House of Commons.

articles.title: Bitcoin back above $81,000 after hot CPI print, BNB, DOGE lead majors gains
articles.snippet: Bitcoin rolled back to $81,200 after dipping to $79,800 on Tuesday's hotter-than-expected U.S. inflation reading, while BNB zoomed 2.5% over 24 hours and dogecoin added 1.3% as crypto funds saw their strongest weekly inflows in months.

articles.title: JPMorgan files to launch new tokenized fund as Wall Street tokenization race heats up
articles.snippet: The global banking giant is expanding its tokenized money market lineup, following BlackRock's similar move just a few days ago.

articles.title: Ethereum community launches security feature to end blind signing
articles.snippet: Crypto platforms Ledger, Trezor, MetaMask, Keycard, WalletConnect, Argot and Fireblocks are among the earliest adopters and contributors to Clear Signing, aimed at ending “blind signing.”
